title: Data Warehousing Basics
description: Introduction to data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS).
longDescription: This module introduces data warehousing fundamentals including dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and an introduction to SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) for OLAP cubes and data mining.
whatYouLearn: Design star and snowflake schemas for dimensional modeling
Understand fact tables, dimension tables, and their relationships
Introduction to SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)
